title: Dataset of intracranial EEG, scalp EEG and beamforming sources from epilepsy patients performing a verbal working memory task
description: This dataset contains simultaneously recorded scalp EEG and intracranial EEG (depth electrodes) from fifteen epilepsy patients undergoing intracranial monitoring while performing a modified Sternberg verbal working memory task. Encoding, maintenance, and recall are temporally separated. It includes electrode MNI coordinates with anatomical labels, trial-level behavioral information, and LCMV beamforming-reconstructed virtual sensor data for several cortical regions. The data support studies of working memory, connectivity, and replay of memory items.
methods_description: Scalp EEG (10-20 system) and depth-electrode iEEG were recorded simultaneously in epilepsy patients performing a modified Sternberg task, with ~50 trials per session across multiple sessions. Virtual EEG sensors were reconstructed with LCMV beamforming at specific brain regions (e.g., auditory cortex, DLPFC, OFC, PPC, V1). Data were converted to BIDS using bids-starter-kid and custom Matlab scripts.
